appId.description: Apple App Store numeric app ID that was scraped.
appId.title: App ID

country.description: Two-letter App Store storefront country code where this review was surfaced.
country.title: Country

reviewId.description: Unique Apple App Store review identifier. Stable across runs; use for dedup.
reviewId.title: Review ID

title.description: Headline of the review, if the author wrote one.
title.title: Review title

updated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the review was posted (Apple does not expose a last-updated time).
updated.title: Posted at

version.description: Version of the app the review was written for. Not exposed by the Apple page source; always empty.
version.title: App version

voteCount.description: Number of users who marked the review helpful. Not exposed by the Apple page source; always 0.
voteCount.title: Helpful votes
